name: Y-API
description: Y-API lists selected zero-cost models and a daily request cap.
overview: Y-API lists selected models as free with no credit deducted, alongside a one-time $1 signup credit. Trial accounts have 100 requests per day shared across all models; daily check-in raises that day to 200. No card is needed at signup. Its upstream can withdraw a free flag and calls then start billing at listed prices without a code change.
free_access: Daily check-in raises that day to 200
Free model flags can change to paid without code changes
notes: Use deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash and check the live price before calling; the provider warns free routes may become paid.
